name: 53-budget-flash-low-small
description: Legacy flash family, reasoningEffort 'low' with maxTokens 100: floor(100 * 0.1) = 10 and the only clamp is Math.min(budgetTokens, 24576) at :1205, so the answer is 10. getFlashLiteBudget's floor of 512 would have lifted the same input to 512, and the flash family has no floor. Expected value: 10.
